title: When does a subagent take over?
intro: This project has a subagent named test-runner, described as running the test suite and reporting failures. Pick what you ask.

inputs.label: Your request
options: Run the tests and tell me what fails

when.equals: Run the tests and tell me what fails

show.title: Delegated by description
show.detail: The request matches the subagent's description, so Claude can hand the task to it. The subagent works in its own context and only its report comes back.

trace.text: Runs the suite with its own tools.

show.title: Delegated by name
show.detail: Mentioning the subagent asks for it directly.

trace.text: Runs the auth tests and reports back.

show.title: Stays in the main conversation
show.detail: Nothing about this task matches test-runner's description, so Claude does it itself.

quiz.question: What comes back to your main conversation when a subagent finishes?
quiz.explanation: A subagent works in its own context window, so only its result returns, keeping the main conversation small.
